blocks.title: Disproportionation reaction
blocks.text: Disproportionation reaction woh kimiyai reaction hai jis mein ek hi madda oxidising aur reducing agent dono ka kaam karta hai, mukhtalif oxidation states wale do mukhtalif products deta hua: ek hi element ek saath oxidise aur reduce hota hai.

Hydrogen peroxide ka pani aur oxygen mein tootna, 2H2O2 se 2H2O + O2, disproportionation hai: oxygen H2O2 mein -1, H2O mein -2 (-1 se -2 reduced) aur O2 mein 0 (-1 se 0 oxidised) hai. Isi tarah garam sodium hydroxide ke saath chlorine, Cl2 + 6NaOH se 5NaCl + NaClO3 + 3H2O (print ka muadla garbled hai): chlorine Cl2 mein 0, NaCl mein -1 (0 se -1 reduced) aur NaClO3 mein +5 (0 se +5 oxidised). Disproportionation wahan ho sakta hai jahan ions ya molecules kai oxidation states mein maujood ho sakein.

blocks.prompt: 3HNO2 se HNO3 + 2NO + H2O mein woh species pehchanein jo oxidation aur reduction dono se guzarti hai (Quick Check 10.2b).
blocks.explanation: HNO2 mein nitrogen +3 hai. HNO3 mein +5 (oxidised) aur NO mein +2 (reduced), to nitrous acid disproportionate hota hai: HNO2 oxidising aur reducing agent dono hai.

items: Disproportionation: ek element oxidise aur reduce dono hota hai (H2O2: O -1 se -2 aur 0; NaOH mein Cl2: Cl 0 se -1 aur +5); kai oxidation states wala element chahiye.
